boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten documented Elmhurst University settings for solo work, group projects, tutoring and between-class study, with access limits and useful physical features noted.

cards.entity_name: A.C. Buehler Library Lower-Level General Study Area
cards.title: Spread Out on the Lower Level
cards.subtitle: Tables, chairs and nearby academic support in A.C. Buehler Library
cards.notes: Bring materials that need room to spread out; the lower level combines tables and chairs with nearby study rooms and career support.
cards.short_summary: A table-oriented library setting suited to sustained individual work.
cards.evidence_claim: Elmhurst University identifies the library's lower level as having study rooms and general study areas with chairs and tables, plus access to the Weigand Career Center.
cards.access_notes: Located on the lower level of A.C. Buehler Library; use is subject to current library building access and hours.

cards.entity_name: A.C. Buehler Library First-Level Study Area
cards.title: Work Near Computers and Sofas
cards.subtitle: A flexible main-floor setup for digital work or a softer seat
cards.notes: Choose this level when you need a campus computer or want to switch between a table and sofa without leaving the library.
cards.short_summary: A mixed-seating floor with computers and convenient access to tutoring.
cards.evidence_claim: Elmhurst University states that the library's first level has computers, tables and sofas, with tutoring available in the Learning Center.
cards.access_notes: Located on the first level of A.C. Buehler Library; use is subject to current library building access and hours.

cards.entity_name: A.C. Buehler Library Second-Level Open Study Area
cards.title: Settle In Upstairs
cards.subtitle: Open tables and chairs beside reservable study-room options
cards.notes: Use the open upstairs tables when you do not need an enclosed room; move to a reservable room if the assignment becomes collaborative.
cards.short_summary: An upstairs open-study option with individual and group rooms nearby.
cards.evidence_claim: Elmhurst University documents tables and chairs on the library's second level alongside group and individual study rooms.
cards.access_notes: Located on the second level of A.C. Buehler Library; use is subject to current library building access and hours.

cards.entity_name: A.C. Buehler Library Upper-Level Group Study Rooms
cards.title: Reserve a Room for Group Work
cards.subtitle: Enclosed upper-level rooms designed for collaborative study
cards.notes: Reserve ahead for a project meeting, and confirm equipment when booking if your group needs a display for presentation practice.
cards.short_summary: Reservable group rooms for discussion, collaboration and presentations.
cards.evidence_claim: Elmhurst University says group study rooms are on the library's upper level and can be reserved; an official library guide notes many have large-screen televisions that connect to laptops.
cards.source_title: Commuter Students | Info and Resources | Elmhurst University
cards.access_notes: Reservation is required to claim a room; follow the linked library booking process and current library access rules.

cards.entity_name: A.C. Buehler Library Lower-Level Single Study Rooms
cards.title: Book a Room for Solo Focus
cards.subtitle: Reservable single-user rooms on the library's lower level
cards.notes: Book a single room for concentrated reading or independent work, then arrive within the reservation window shown by the library system.
cards.short_summary: An enclosed, reservable alternative to the library's open seating.
cards.evidence_claim: Elmhurst University's commuter FAQ identifies single study rooms on the lower level of A.C. Buehler Library, while its commuter resource page directs users to reserve study rooms.
cards.access_notes: These lower-level rooms are reservable; consult the library booking system for current eligibility, availability and time limits.

cards.title: Pair Study Time With Tutoring
cards.subtitle: Academic support and study groups on Buehler Library's main level
cards.notes: Check the tutoring schedule before visiting, bring the assignment and your questions, and book an appointment when the service requires one.
cards.short_summary: A study-support setting for tutoring, workshops and subject-based groups.
cards.evidence_claim: The Learning Center is on the main level of A.C. Buehler Library and offers in-person tutoring, study groups and academic workshops during fall and spring terms.
cards.source_title: The Learning Center | Academic Tutoring | Elmhurst University
cards.access_notes: Academic services are for Elmhurst University students; fall and spring offerings vary, and appointments should be made through the posted schedule.

cards.title: Study by the Founders Lounge Fireplace
cards.subtitle: Second-floor Frick Center seating with tables and work amenities
cards.notes: Bring reading or laptop work here when you want lounge seating; public printers and scanners are available for document-heavy tasks.
cards.short_summary: A spacious Frick Center lounge with couches, tables and practical print tools.
cards.evidence_claim: Elmhurst University places Founders Lounge on the Frick Center's second floor and documents comfortable seating, work tables, a fireplace, public printers and scanners.
cards.source_title: Commuter Students | Info and Resources | Elmhurst University
cards.access_notes: The lounge is inside the Frick Center and can host events or club meetings, so check campus scheduling and building access before relying on it.

cards.title: Use the Commuter Lounge Between Classes
cards.subtitle: Tables and comfortable seating beside Bluejays' Roost
cards.notes: Set up here between classes, and ask at the Frick Center Information Desk if you also need instructions for reserving a commuter locker.
cards.short_summary: A Frick Center study-and-reset space specifically highlighted for commuters.
cards.evidence_claim: Elmhurst University locates the Commuter Lounge next to Bluejays' Roost in the Frick Center and describes it as having numerous tables and seats for studying or relaxing.
cards.source_title: Commuter Students | Info and Resources | Elmhurst University
cards.access_notes: Intended as a commuter-student amenity inside the Frick Center; use is subject to current student-center access.

cards.title: Combine Coursework With a Cafe Break
cards.subtitle: Main-floor library seating where schoolwork is explicitly welcomed
cards.notes: Use the seating without assuming a purchase is required; check dining hours separately if you plan to order coffee, snacks or other food.
cards.short_summary: A more social library setting for lighter work and informal collaboration.
cards.evidence_claim: Elmhurst University's commuter FAQ says the Library Cafe has seating where students can do schoolwork and identifies Starbucks plus additional food and drink options there.
cards.access_notes: Located on A.C. Buehler Library's main floor; cafe service follows dining hours, while seating access depends on current library rules.

cards.title: Bring Club Work to the SOC
cards.subtitle: A seating area and workspace inside Bluejays' Roost
cards.notes: Use the workspace for organization planning or individual tasks, and bring a charging cable because the University lists a charging station here.
cards.short_summary: A practical Frick Center workspace with seating and device charging nearby.
cards.evidence_claim: Elmhurst University's commuter FAQ says the Student Organization Center in Bluejays' Roost contains seating and a student workspace; it also lists a Frick Center charging station there.
cards.access_notes: Located within Bluejays' Roost in the Frick Center; use is subject to current student-center and SOC access.

warnings: The title's “Claimed by 9am” language is treated only as supplied editorial framing; no claim about crowding or student arrival behavior is made.
Exact coordinates and map URLs for these interior study environments were not verified, so those fields are null.
The official source confirms Library Cafe seating can be used for schoolwork but does not state that seating requires a purchase; purchase_required refers only to optional cafe food and beverages.
